facts.fact: KICTANet's KenSafeSpace network says it ran its first rapid-response protocol during a 2024 Telegram shutdown in Kenya; the document does not say who ordered it or when it ended.
The document says network members issued joint statements and gathered evidence during the internet shutdowns of June 2024 in Kenya; it does not say who ordered them or where.
The document names the KenSafeSpace civil-society network as pushing back against the ICT Practitioners Bill; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.
